column1: 2221|I left the window open, so the room got cold.|창문을 열어 둬서 방이 추워졌어.|Daily life|Beginner|Use when explaining why a room suddenly feels cold.
2222|Could you remind me to water the plants tonight?|오늘 밤에 식물에 물 주라고 알려 줄래?|Daily life|Beginner|Use when asking someone to help you remember a small task.
2223|I will sort the laundry after I finish this.|이거 끝내고 빨래를 분류할게.|Daily life|Beginner|Use when putting off a simple chore for a short time.
2224|The drawer is stuck because something is blocking it.|뭔가 걸려 있어서 서랍이 안 열려.|Daily life|Intermediate|Use when explaining why a drawer will not open.
2225|I have been trying to use up the food in the fridge.|냉장고에 있는 음식을 다 먹으려고 하고 있어.|Daily life|Intermediate|Use when talking about reducing food waste at home.
2226|I did not realize how much time had passed.|시간이 그렇게 많이 지난 줄 몰랐어.|Daily life|Intermediate|Use when you are surprised that an activity took so long.
2227|Let us leave a little earlier in case traffic is heavy.|차가 막힐 수도 있으니 조금 일찍 출발하자.|Daily life|Intermediate|Use when suggesting extra travel time as a precaution.
2228|I need a quiet place to clear my head.|생각을 정리할 조용한 곳이 필요해.|Daily life|Intermediate|Use when you need a calm place after a busy day.
2229|The package was delivered to the wrong building.|택배가 다른 건물로 잘못 배달됐어.|Shopping|Beginner|Use when reporting a delivery problem.
2230|Could I exchange this for a different size?|이거 다른 사이즈로 교환할 수 있을까요?|Shopping|Intermediate|Use when asking a store to exchange clothing or another item.
2231|The price includes delivery, right?|배송비가 포함된 가격 맞죠?|Shopping|Beginner|Use when checking whether delivery is included in the listed price.
2232|I am comparing a few options before I decide.|결정하기 전에 몇 가지 선택지를 비교하고 있어.|Shopping|Intermediate|Use when explaining that you are still considering a purchase.
2233|This one looks practical, but it is a little expensive.|이건 실용적으로 보이지만 조금 비싸.|Shopping|Intermediate|Use when weighing usefulness against price.
2234|Do you have anything similar in a darker color?|좀 더 어두운 색으로 비슷한 제품이 있나요?|Shopping|Intermediate|Use when asking for a similar item in another color.
2235|The meeting can start once everyone joins the call.|모두 통화에 들어오면 회의를 시작할 수 있어.|Work|Intermediate|Use when explaining what needs to happen before a meeting starts.
2236|I will send a short summary after the meeting.|회의 후에 간단한 요약을 보낼게.|Work|Beginner|Use when promising to share the main points later.
2237|Could we move this discussion to the afternoon?|이 논의를 오후로 미룰 수 있을까요?|Work|Intermediate|Use when politely requesting a different discussion time.
2238|I need a little more context before I can comment.|의견을 말하려면 상황을 조금 더 알아야 해.|Work|Advanced|Use when you need more background before giving an opinion.
2239|The deadline is still possible, but we need to stay focused.|마감일을 맞출 수는 있지만 집중해서 진행해야 해.|Work|Advanced|Use when a deadline is achievable but requires discipline.
2240|I will flag the main risk in the next update.|다음 업데이트에서 주요 위험 요소를 짚을게.|Work|Advanced|Use when promising to point out an important concern.
2241|I missed the announcement because my notifications were off.|알림을 꺼 둬서 공지를 놓쳤어.|Technology|Intermediate|Use when explaining why you did not see a notification.
2242|The app keeps logging me out.|이 앱은 자꾸 로그아웃돼.|Technology|Beginner|Use when an app repeatedly ends your session.
2243|I backed up the files before changing the settings.|설정을 바꾸기 전에 파일을 백업했어.|Technology|Intermediate|Use when describing a precaution before making a technical change.
2244|The screen is brighter than I expected.|화면이 생각보다 더 밝아.|Technology|Beginner|Use when describing an unexpectedly bright display.
2245|Could you share the link in the group chat?|그 링크를 단체 채팅방에 공유해 줄래?|Technology|Beginner|Use when asking someone to post a link for everyone.
2246|I would rather update the software when I have more time.|시간이 좀 더 있을 때 소프트웨어를 업데이트하고 싶어.|Technology|Advanced|Use when postponing a software update until you are less busy.
2247|The train was delayed, but I still arrived on time.|기차가 지연됐지만 그래도 제시간에 도착했어.|Travel|Intermediate|Use when describing a delay that did not make you late.
2248|Is this seat available, or is someone sitting here?|이 자리 비어 있나요, 아니면 누가 앉는 자리인가요?|Travel|Beginner|Use when checking whether you can take a seat.
2249|I would like to check in one bag.|가방 하나를 부치고 싶어요.|Travel|Beginner|Use when checking one bag at an airport.
2250|We took the wrong turn near the station.|역 근처에서 길을 잘못 들었어.|Travel|Beginner|Use when explaining that you went the wrong way.
2251|Could you tell me which platform the train leaves from?|기차가 어느 승강장에서 출발하는지 알려 주시겠어요?|Travel|Intermediate|Use when asking for a train platform.
2252|The view was worth the long ride.|오래 이동한 보람이 있을 만큼 경치가 좋았어.|Travel|Advanced|Use when saying that a view justified a tiring journey.
2253|I have been drinking more water lately.|요즘 물을 더 많이 마시고 있어.|Health|Beginner|Use when describing a recent healthy habit.
2254|My shoulders feel tight after sitting all day.|하루 종일 앉아 있었더니 어깨가 뻐근해.|Health|Intermediate|Use when describing stiffness after prolonged sitting.
2255|I am going to take a short walk before dinner.|저녁 먹기 전에 잠깐 산책할 거야.|Health|Beginner|Use when talking about a light activity before a meal.
2256|I should probably get more sleep this week.|이번 주에는 아무래도 잠을 더 자야 할 것 같아.|Health|Intermediate|Use when recognizing that you have not been sleeping enough.
2257|The headache is mild, so I am going to rest for now.|두통이 심하지 않아서 일단 쉬려고 해.|Health|Intermediate|Use when describing a mild symptom and a simple plan.
2258|I feel better when I keep a regular schedule.|규칙적인 생활을 하면 몸 상태가 더 좋아.|Health|Advanced|Use when explaining why a consistent routine helps you.
2259|It was nice talking with you after such a long time.|정말 오랜만에 이야기해서 좋았어.|Social|Beginner|Use when ending a pleasant conversation after a long time apart.
2260|I am glad we finally found time to meet.|드디어 만날 시간을 내서 다행이야.|Social|Intermediate|Use when expressing happiness about meeting after delays.
2261|Would you like to join us for a casual dinner?|우리랑 편하게 저녁 먹으러 갈래?|Social|Beginner|Use when inviting someone to an informal dinner.
2262|I do not want to put you on the spot.|너를 곤란한 입장에 세우고 싶지는 않아.|Social|Advanced|Use when avoiding pressure on someone to answer immediately.
2263|Let me know if you would rather keep it low-key.|조용하고 편하게 하고 싶다면 알려 줘.|Social|Advanced|Use when offering a less elaborate social plan.
2264|I appreciate you checking in on me.|내 안부를 물어봐 줘서 고마워.|Social|Intermediate|Use when thanking someone for showing concern.
2265|I think the simpler approach will be easier to maintain.|더 단순한 방식이 유지하기 쉬울 것 같아.|Opinion|Advanced|Use when recommending a practical approach that can last.
2266|I am not completely convinced that this is necessary.|이게 꼭 필요한지는 완전히 확신이 안 서.|Opinion|Advanced|Use when expressing polite doubt about a proposal.
2267|That sounds reasonable, given the time we have.|우리에게 주어진 시간을 생각하면 합리적으로 들려.|Opinion|Advanced|Use when agreeing with a plan in light of a time limit.
2268|I would keep the original plan unless something changes.|뭔가 바뀌지 않는 한 원래 계획대로 할 것 같아.|Opinion|Advanced|Use when favoring an existing plan while remaining flexible.
2269|The main issue is not the cost but the timing.|가장 큰 문제는 비용이 아니라 시기야.|Opinion|Intermediate|Use when clarifying what the real concern is.
2270|It may be worth trying once before we rule it out.|제외하기 전에 한 번쯤 시도해 볼 가치는 있을 것 같아.|Opinion|Advanced|Use when suggesting a fair trial before rejecting an idea.
